verdict.rationale: Extend documents some event-driven pieces. There is webhook configuration for run events, and production runs fire webhooks. Deployable, versioned workflows exist. Confidence scores can auto-trust high-confidence values and route the rest to human review, which works like a threshold rule. However, no documented general rule engine lets users define custom event→action triggers; the evidence is mostly page titles and short snippets. missing for 10: explicit user-defined rule/trigger configuration, documented event types and conditional action mapping, detail on how workflows are triggered automatically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
